stories.title: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to ‘pace the frontier’
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic's leader is talking about slowing down how fast AI companies are pushing forward with new AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly discussion among AI company leaders — nothing that directly affects your daily life or business right now.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO calls for the AI industry to slow down
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic's leader is calling on the entire AI industry to move more slowly instead of racing to build bigger AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly discussion among AI company leaders — nothing that directly affects your daily life or business right now.

stories.title: Trump is giving data centers a pass to pollute
stories.simple_summary: President Trump is relaxing pollution rules so companies can build big computer data centers for AI faster. Former environmental protection officials warn this could make the air and water less safe in those areas.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near where data centers are being built, pollution rules might be weaker — but most people won't be directly affected.

stories.title: Brics summit: Xi urges states to stand on ‘right side of history’, floats AI plan
stories.simple_summary: China's leader Xi Jinping is talking about AI plans at an international meeting with other countries.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about government and international relations — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ‘Immature playground boasting’: Mathematicians uneasy at OpenAI’s latest scalp
stories.simple_summary: Mathematicians are unhappy that OpenAI is bragging about its AI solving hard math problems and calling it a big win.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly technical disagreement among experts — nothing that affects you directly.

stories.title: OpenAI just wants to win
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced its AI solved a very difficult, famous math problem that experts have been trying to solve for years.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is getting better at complex thinking, but it's mainly interesting to mathematicians and researchers — not something you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI reveals another rogue AI attack
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI reported that someone managed to trick its AI into doing something it shouldn't (an "attack" means someone found a way to make it misbehave).
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI systems have security problems, but this is mostly important to AI experts and businesses using AI — nothing urgent for you.

stories.title: DNI warns of artificial intelligence national security risks
stories.simple_summary: A top U.S. national security official warned that AI technology could create serious security and safety risks for the country.
stories.why_it_matters: This is government officials discussing future risks — nothing you need to do right now, but it shows policymakers are paying attention.

stories.title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
stories.simple_summary: A startup company called Mecka that helps teach robots how to do things is getting close to being valued at $500 million from an investment deal.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investor news — nothing that directly affects you.

stories.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
stories.simple_summary: A leader from an investment group wants American AI companies to create smaller, more available versions of their powerful AI systems so other American companies can use them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about what technology company leaders want to build — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
stories.simple_summary: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed a letter complaining that OpenAI and other AI companies are using and claiming credit for mathematical work without proper respect.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a disagreement between AI companies and the math community — nothing that affects you directly.

stories.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
stories.simple_summary: A lawyer got fined $5,000 because he used AI to create fake witnesses and fake police reports in a court case, and he didn't check if they were real before using them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an important warning: if you ever need a lawyer, you should know that some people might try to use AI-invented information in court — ask your lawyer to verify everything they use.
